title.ja: 図1-1 藤井システムの基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of the Fujii System

explain.ja: 図1-1は藤井システムの基本形です。藤井システムは四間飛車の一種で、左辺の駒組みは普通の四間飛車とほとんど同じですが、玉をまったく囲わないのが特徴で、1手でも早く攻めることを狙います。居飛車穴熊や天守閣美濃のようにじっくり囲ってくる相手に効果抜群で、速攻で囲いを崩せます。
explain.en: 図1-1 is the basic form of the Fujii System. It is a type of Ranging Rook whose left-side development is almost the same as the normal Ranging Rook, but it does not castle the king at all, aiming to attack even one move sooner. It is highly effective against opponents who build slowly, such as the Anaguma or Tenshukaku Mino, breaking their castles with a fast attack.

section.ja: 藤井システムの基本形、居玉のまま四間飛車に組んで速攻を狙う!
section.en: Basic form of the Fujii System: build Fourth File Rook with the king unmoved and aim for a quick attack!

title.ja: 図2-1 普通の四間飛車の出だし
title.en: Figure 2-1: Opening of an ordinary Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: ここからは藤井システムの基本形に至るまでの駒組みを初手から解説します。まずはノーマル四間飛車と同じように、角道を閉じて飛車を四間に構えます。基本的にはよくある四間飛車と同じです。
explain.en: From here we explain the setup up to the Fujii System's basic form, starting from the first move. First, as in the normal Ranging Rook, close the bishop diagonal and place the rook on the fourth file. Basically it is the same as a usual Ranging Rook.

section.ja: ノーマル四間飛車の出だし
section.en: Opening of Normal Fourth File Rook

title.ja: 図2-2 相手が穴熊か聞く
title.en: Figure 2-2: Ask whether the opponent is going for Anaguma

explain.ja: 藤井システムでは、早めに▲1六歩と端歩を突くのがポイントです。これに相手が△1四歩と突き返せば急戦の可能性が高く、突き返さなければ穴熊に組んで持久戦にしてくる可能性が高くなります。これは相手が穴熊かどうかを尋ねる手です。相手が急戦の駒組みをしてきたら、藤井システムは諦めて普通の四間飛車に組むのがおすすめです。
explain.en: In the Fujii System the key is to push the edge pawn early with ▲1六歩. If the opponent answers with △1四歩, a rapid attack is likely; if not, the opponent will probably build an Anaguma and play a slow game. This move asks whether the opponent is going for the Anaguma. If the opponent sets up for a rapid attack, it is recommended to give up the Fujii System and build a normal Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 早めに端歩を突くのがポイント
section.en: The key is to push the edge pawn early

title.ja: 図2-3 相手は穴熊を目指している？
title.en: Figure 2-3: Is the opponent aiming for Anaguma?

explain.ja: こちらが端歩を突いた手に対し、相手は突き返さずに駒組みを進めてきました。端を突いてこない場合、相手は居飛車穴熊に組んでくる可能性が高いので、藤井システムの駒組みを目指します。居飛車穴熊に対しては藤井システムで対抗します。
explain.en: The opponent did not push back the edge pawn and continued development. When the edge pawn is not pushed, the opponent will probably build the Anaguma, so Black aims for the Fujii System setup. The Fujii System is the answer to the Static Rook Anaguma.

section.ja: 早めに端歩を突くのがポイント
section.en: The key is to push the edge pawn early

title.ja: 図2-4 金銀だけ美濃囲いの形に
title.en: Figure 2-4: Only gold and silver into Mino shape

explain.ja: 藤井システムでは、玉は居玉のまま、金銀だけを美濃囲いの形に組むのがポイントです。1筋や2筋で戦いを起こすことが多いため、玉を深く囲うより居玉のほうが安全な場合もよくあります。居玉の駒組みが藤井システム最大の特徴です。
explain.en: In the Fujii System the king stays on its starting square while only the golds and silvers are arranged in a Mino castle shape. Since fights often start on the 1st and 2nd files, leaving the king at home is often safer than castling deeply. The uncastled king is the greatest hallmark of the Fujii System.

section.ja: 居玉のまま、金銀だけ美濃囲いの形に
section.en: Keeping the king at home, form the Mino shape with gold and silver only

title.ja: 図2-5 藤井システムの基本形
title.en: Figure 2-5: Basic form of the Fujii System

explain.ja: 玉を動かさないまま駒組みを進め、藤井システムの基本形ができあがりました。ここから相手は、そのまま居飛車穴熊に組む、急戦に切り替える、左美濃に組むなど、いくつかの方針を選べます。相手の出方しだいで、こちらの方針も大きく変わります。
explain.en: Black has developed without moving the king, and the basic Fujii System formation is complete. From here White can go for an Ibisha Anaguma, switch to a quick attack, or build a Left Mino. Our plan changes greatly depending on which one White picks.

section.ja: 居玉のまま、金銀だけ美濃囲いの形に
section.en: Keeping the king at home, form the Mino shape with gold and silver only

note.ja: 記事の△5三歩は図では△5四歩です。また▲4六歩が省略されているため補っています。
note.en: The article's △5三歩 is △5四歩 in the figure, and ▲4六歩 is left out; both are reflected here.

title.ja: 図3-1 藤井システムvs居飛車穴熊
title.en: Figure 3-1: Fujii System vs Static Rook Anaguma

explain.ja: 藤井システムといえば、居飛車穴熊と戦う形がいちばん有名です。この戦法には狙いの攻め筋が多いので、まず居飛車穴熊との戦い方から学んでいきましょう。居飛車穴熊を崩す手順は特に有名です。
explain.en: The Fujii System is best known for the way it fights an Ibisha Anaguma. It has many attacking patterns aimed at that castle, so start by learning how to play against it. The sequence for breaking down an Anaguma is especially famous.

section.ja: 藤井システムと言えばこれ!居飛車穴熊崩し
section.en: This is the Fujii System! Breaking Static Rook Anaguma

title.ja: 図3-2 藤井システムvs左美濃
title.en: Figure 3-2: Fujii System vs Left Mino

explain.ja: 藤井システムは、左美濃(天守閣美濃)に対しても強く戦えます。居飛車穴熊への攻め筋とは狙いが少し違うので、手順をよく知っておきましょう。相手の囲いも堅そうですが、玉頭から崩していきます。
explain.en: The Fujii System also fights well against Left Mino (the Tenshukaku Mino). Its aims differ a little from the attack against an Anaguma, so learn the sequence well. The opponent's castle looks solid, but we break it down from the king's head.

section.ja: 天守閣美濃を玉頭から崩そう!
section.en: Break down Tenshukaku Mino from the king's head

title.ja: 図3-3 藤井システムvs居飛車急戦
title.en: Figure 3-3: Fujii System vs Static Rook rapid attack

explain.ja: 藤井システムは、穴熊や左美濃のような持久戦に速攻を仕掛けるのが狙いです。そのため相手は、藤井システムの駒組みを見て急戦に構えてくることも多いです。急戦との戦いでも、正しく指せば互角に戦えます。1手でも遅れると相手の攻めを受けきれなくなるので注意しましょう。
explain.en: The Fujii System aims to launch a fast attack against slow games such as Anaguma or Left Mino. For that reason, opponents who see the Fujii formation often set up a quick attack instead. Played correctly, it can still hold even against a quick attack, but being one move late means you can no longer withstand the opponent's attack.

section.ja: 急戦に対してはどう戦う?
section.en: How to fight against a fast attack?
